row: Justin Yee, Physiotherapist struggles to find time to make remotely entertaining and hopefully useful physiotherapy videos. Balancing between a full time job as a physiotherapist, co running an online platform for kombucha subscriptions, being in a relationship, trying to keep up with my passion of rock climbing, participating in church activities, maintaining my strength and fitness at the gym, all while trying to get enough sleep, drink enough water, eat well and trying not to go insane.
